By bringing together Agentic AI, intelligent orchestration and human expertise, we're creating workplaces where people simply achieve what they set out to do—without thinking about the systems making it possible. Kelly Candler Global Offering Lead, Workplace & Business Process Services, DXC Technology What makes frictionless workplace experiences possible Support Services DXC Support Services replaces the wait and friction of traditional IT support with agentic AI at the core of every interaction. Issues resolve autonomously wherever possible—without new tools or habits—meeting employees in Teams, chat, voice, and email. Complex cases route instantly to the right specialist. Supporting 36+ million contacts annually across 56 person to person and 109 digital languages and recognized as a leader by ISG and Nelson Hall, DXC gets employees back to productivity faster. LEARN MORE Device Services DXC Device Services simplifies managing large, diverse device fleets so employees never feel the complexity. Lifecycle management, AI-driven device intelligence, and performance-based refresh bundle into a single managed service—devices arrive ready to work and stay that way. Self-healing automation resolves common issues before they reach the service desk, while AI scoring determines when a device actually needs refreshing instead of following a fixed schedule. Managing 6.9+ million devices and 1+ million virtual desktops globally, DXC is a recognized leader in device services. DXC Workplace Experience transforms disconnected collaboration tools and legacy systems into a connected, standardized experience with vendor-agnostic meeting room hardware. Managing 5+ million seats and 15,000 meeting rooms globally, DXC is recognized for its Workplace Services by ISG and Nelson Hall. LEARN MORE Built on the technologies you already trust DXC works closely with the world's leading workplace technology providers to integrate AI, cloud, collaboration, endpoint management and digital workflow capabilities into a single, intelligent employee experience. Rather than replacing existing investments, we help customers maximize the value of the platforms they already rely on every day. Connect with a DXC Workplace Expert The workplace has changed. Your IT experience should change with it. CONTACT US Proven where it matters We turn global scale into better workplace experiences. Every customer engagement benefits from decades of operational expertise, AI-driven automation and insights gained from supporting hundreds of enterprise environments worldwide. At a glance 435+ enterprise customers Operations in 70 countries 7 million managed devices 5 million Microsoft 365 seats supported Support for 109 digital languages Reimagining the employee experience Wherever your employees work, DXC helps create a connected, consistent and intelligent experience designed around the people who use it. The workplace keeps improving itself A modern workplace shouldn't depend on constant manual intervention. AI automation, self-healing devices and DXC OASIS continuously optimize workplace performance, giving IT a single view across the environment while reducing day-to-day effort. Problems are prevented—not reported By the time someone contacts the service desk, productivity has already been lost. The solution continuously detects and resolves many issues before employees notice them, reducing operational complexity by 40%, cutting service desk calls by 60% and returning more than 15 productive hours every month to every employee. Employees stay in the flow People shouldn't stop work to deal with technology. Support meets employees where they already work, delivering fast, personalized help without disrupting productivity. Technology works together Employees shouldn't have to navigate the systems behind their work. DXC connects AI, automation and workplace services through a single orchestration layer, turning fragmented technologies into one seamless experience for employees and one operational view for IT. Why today's workplace falls short Too many technologies. Not enough connection. Organizations have invested heavily in workplace technology over the last decade. The problem isn't a lack of capability. It's that platforms, workflows and support models often operate independently, creating unnecessary complexity for both employees and IT. Employees experience the symptoms. IT sees the tickets. Modern workplaces need to anticipate problems before they disrupt work—not simply resolve them faster. Availability isn't the same as productivity. Traditional SLAs measure whether systems are running. They don't measure whether employees can actually do their jobs effectively. That's why DXC measures workplace experience through XLAs—capturing the outcomes that matter most to the business. A workplace that works the way your people do. Imagine technology that detects issues, diagnoses problems, recommends actions and often resolves them automatically. That's what intelligent orchestration makes possible. 1/4 Insights Transforming the digital workplace with agentic AI Explore how AI-powered agents are helping enterprises create more adaptive workplaces, automate tasks and deliver more personalized employee experiences. Learn more Submit THANK YOU FOR CONTACTING US A DXC solutions expert will be in touch shortly. FAQ What are workplace services? Workplace services bring together the capabilities employees rely on every day, including service desk and support services, device lifecycle management, collaboration services, digital workplace experience and IT asset management. DXC unifies these services with Agentic AI, intelligent orchestration and human expertise to create workplace experiences that are proactive, personalized and continuously improving. What makes DXC's approach different? Rather than introducing more tools or replacing existing investments, DXC connects and orchestrates the technologies you already have to maximize the value of your existing workplace ecosystem. AI, automation and human expertise work together to anticipate employee needs, resolve issues proactively and continuously improve workplace performance. Designed around how employees already work, the experience is easier to adopt, easier to manage and delivers better outcomes for both the business and its people. How does AI improve workplace support? AI enables workplace services to move from reactive to proactive. Instead of waiting for employees to report issues, intelligent systems monitor workplace health, identify emerging problems and resolve many incidents automatically before productivity is affected. When / if an employee does need support, we’ve designed a support experience across any channel they prefer (voice, chat, email), immediate response, agentic agents who either do the work for you or guide you through it. No more troubleshooting your own IT issues or being stuck in self-service loops. What is DXC OASIS? DXC OASIS provides IT leaders with a unified operational view of their IT estate. It brings together workplace data, automation and AI-driven insights to improve decision making, optimize service delivery and measure performance against meaningful business outcomes. What are Experience Level Agreements (XLAs)? XLAs measure how employees experience technology rather than simply whether systems remain available. They provide insight into productivity, satisfaction and workplace effectiveness, helping organizations continuously improve the employee experience. How does DXC support global organizations? DXC delivers workplace services across 70 countries, supporting millions of devices and users through global delivery teams with deep industry expertise. Our scale enables organizations to provide a consistent employee experience wherever work happens. Insights Customer stories United Airlines improves travel above and below the wing SHARE Share on LinkedIn Share via Email Customer United Airlines Location Chicago, IL, United States Industries Travel & Transportation Offerings Consulting & Engineering Services Cloud & Infrastructure Customer Stories | June 1, 2025 United Airlines improves travel above and below the wing Flying nearly 5,000 planes each day across the globe while carrying ~500,000 passengers is a daunting task. From mobile check-in to baggage retrieval, a traveler’s journey is made up of numerous touchpoints—each one an opportunity to make the experience more human, more responsive and more connected to a traveler’s unique needs. That’s why United Airlines is both modernizing its core infrastructure to ensure critical operations run smoothly and releasing a suite of mobile apps to access critical flight information, manage schedules for pilots and crew, and keep airline passengers connected and informed during every step of the journey. DXC is helping United Airlines excel in both areas—above and below the wing—to ensure the reliability of United’s critical systems while also building more ambitious applications that propel the airline forward and create delightful travel experiences. A powerhouse for critical tasks You don’t need to be a pilot to know that flight networks are complicated and ever-changing. That’s why airlines rely on mainframes to help ensure that people and planes arrive where they are supposed to in the most efficient way possible. “Modernizing the mainframe is key for us," said Grant Milstead , VP of Digital at United Airlines. "It’s not easy or glamorous work but it’s a big part of unlocking the value we want to create going forward, to continue to scale and grow.” Watch the video Delighting passengers at every turn When you board a United Airlines plane, there’s a lot of work happening behind the scenes—involving flight attendants, pilots, crew and others—to make sure everything is tightly coordinated and that the plane leaves on time. Mobile apps keep airline passengers constantly connected and informed, giving them greater control over their journey. "I think about mobile apps as kind of a travel concierge in your pocket," said Milstead. "It’s personalized, it’s contextual and it’s entirely self-service, so our customers have full control over their travel experience.” The 'connected passenger' has become a reality Providing a seamless, modern customer experience is crucial. And the good news is United does so through its customer app with features that elevate the passenger experience, including: Personal flight info, boarding times, seat assignments Family & friends trip planning “Bag drop shortcut” to check bags ahead and drop them off Flight-change notifications Real-time baggage tracking Agent-on-demand via talk, text or video chat Digital menu for food service The big picture Our work with United Airlines is a great example of how, by taking the right approach to overcoming legacy challenges and embracing modern technologies, an enterprise can maximize the value of existing investments while building IT environments that are more agile, cost-effective and designed for future innovation and a customer-first mindset. It’s also another great example of how we’re partnering with airlines at every step of the journey. Three out of the four largest airlines in the world trust DXC with managing critical data, simplifying passenger check-in, helping the crew track their fleet and modernizing their systems so that they can keep flying.
